title: Che ha detto il medico?
subtitle: Musetta prays for Mimì while the friends talk in whispers; Schaunard finds that she has died, and Rodolfo, the last to understand, throws himself on her body crying her name, La bohème, Act 4

passages.label: Che ha detto il medico? Verrà.; Musetta's prayer, Madonna benedetta ((29), Andante lento e sostenuto); Qui ci vuole un riparo (quasi a piacere)
Così; E che possa guarire; Madonna santa, io sono indegna di perdono; Io spero ancora; Non credo; Schaunard: Marcello, è spirata... (rall.)
(30) a tempo: Colline brings the money: Musetta,.... a voi!...
Come va?; Vedi? È tranquilla (senza voce); Che vuol dire quell'andare e venire... (the lunga pause)
(31) Largo sostenuto: Coraggio....; Mimì!........ Mimì!........; Grave, to the end of the opera

licences.source: Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa, libretto of La bohème (1896)
licences.author: Luigi Illica (1857–1919) and Giuseppe Giacosa (1847–1906)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Ricordi vocal score.

licences.source: G. Ricordi & C. vocal score of La bohème, pages 274-277 (from figure (29), Andante lento e sostenuto, at the top of page 274, to the last bar of the opera on page 277, 45 bars)
licences.author: Carlo Carignani (1857–1919), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each transcribed independently, disagreements settled on the page by a separate judge, then checked against the print and corrected. Rodolfo's part is printed in the treble clef and written here at sounding pitch. The spoken words (Colline's “Come va?..”, Rodolfo's “Vedi?.. È tranquilla.” and “Che vuol dire quell'andare e venire... quel guardarmi così...”, Marcello's “Coraggio....”), printed with stems and flags but no noteheads, are written with cross noteheads. No metronome mark is printed in this piece: the Andante lento e sostenuto at figure (29) (bar 1), the Largo sostenuto at figure (31) (bar 34) and the Grave (bar 42) carry no number and are values chosen from complete recordings as stated in the piece's notes; the a tempo at figure (30) (bar 19) returns to the first tempo.
